safety.title: Safety
safety.description: How cleanup frees space. Use Delete when the drive is almost full.
safety.deleteInPlace: Delete in place (recommended) — frees space immediately, no copy
safety.quarantineSameDrive: Quarantine on same drive — moves to .deco-quarantine, restorable
safety.deleteHint: Delete in place does not store backups. Use it when cleaning C: or when the disk is almost full.
safety.diskHdd: HDD / sequential — one folder at a time
safety.diskHint: HDD mode deletes one tree at a time (best for mechanical drives). Pause/resume is available during cleanup.
safety.fastDeleteDesc: When deleting in place, removes node_modules, target, and build folders via system commands (Windows rmdir /s /q, Unix rm -rf). Parallelism follows Settings → Cleanup disk mode (HDD = one tree at a time) and Scan behavior → Performance. Not used for quarantine.
safety.quarantineEnableHint: Enable by choosing “Quarantine on same drive” above. Payloads are never stored under AppData unless you pick that folder yourself.
safety.quarantineCustom: Custom folder — you choose the path
safety.systemDriveWarning: This folder is on the system (C:) drive — quarantine will use space on C:.
safety.classifyHint: Rayon classify runs when a chunk has at least this many targets (default 8).

experimental.title: Experimental
experimental.description: Opt-in engine probes. Disabled by default.
experimental.ntfsUsnDesc: Each scan adds warnings that report whether the NTFS update journal is readable on drive-letter volumes used by the scan. Discovery still uses a full directory walk. On macOS and Linux this option has no effect.

ideStorageGuide.title: IDE data on the OS drive (manual guide)
ideStorageGuide.description: How tools like Cursor and VS Code use AppData, and a cautious manual junction procedure. Not guaranteed — Deco does not run migration for you.
ideStorageGuide.disclaimer: Wrong moves can destroy profiles. Use Plan first; the manual guide below is always available as a fallback.
ideStorageGuide.intro: When C: is small, IDEs and agents store gigabytes under %APPDATA% and %LOCALAPPDATA%. Moving that data requires a careful, tool-specific procedure — not a single button.
ideStorageGuide.decoRole: Deco reclaims developer-regenerable waste (node_modules, build outputs, caches) on scan roots you choose. It does not replace temp-file cleaners on C: and does not guarantee IDE relocation.
ideStorageGuide.easierToolsTitle: Tools that move more easily (use their settings)
ideStorageGuide.easierToolsNpm: npm / pnpm — configurable cache and store paths
ideStorageGuide.easierToolsDocker: Docker Desktop — data disk / WSL location in Docker settings
ideStorageGuide.easierToolsRustGo: Rust / Go — CARGO_HOME, GOPATH, GOCACHE on another drive
ideStorageGuide.chatWarning: Chat and settings often live under Roaming\…\User. Do not delete workspaceStorage or globalStorage unless you intend to lose history.
ideStorageGuide.manualStep1: Quit the IDE completely (Task Manager and tray).
ideStorageGuide.manualStep2: Copy the folder to NTFS on another drive (e.g. robocopy).
ideStorageGuide.manualStep3: Rename the original folder on C: as a backup.
ideStorageGuide.manualStep4: Create a directory junction: mklink /J "original path" "new path".
ideStorageGuide.manualStep5: Start the IDE and verify settings, extensions, and projects.
ideStorageGuide.manualStep6: After stable use, delete the backup on C: to free space.
ideStorageGuide.manualNtsf: Full commands, rollback, and cache-only cleanup are in the linked guide.
ideStorageGuide.saferTitle: Often safer than moving the whole profile
ideStorageGuide.saferTemp: Clear %TEMP% and Windows Storage → Temporary files
ideStorageGuide.saferCache: Delete Local\Cursor (or Code) Cache / CachedData / GPUCache with the IDE quit
ideStorageGuide.saferScan: Scan C:\Users\You with Deco for dev caches — not Roaming chat databases

toolMigration.title: Tool storage migration (Windows)
toolMigration.description: Move AppData folders (IDEs, browsers, utilities, games) off C: with a directory junction at the original path. Plan, review, then Run.
toolMigration.planFirstNote: Pick a tool and destination, then Plan. Review paths, size, and warnings before Run migration.
toolMigration.runConfirmDescription: Deco will copy data to the destination, rename the original folder as a backup, and create a directory junction at the original path. Close the tool completely (Task Manager and tray) before proceeding.
toolMigration.runConfirmBundleNote: This profile migrates multiple folders (e.g. Roaming + Local). Each leg runs in order.
toolMigration.customModeDescription: Migrate a specific path not in the list below — dot-folders (.claude), game Mods, or other large folders.
toolMigration.customModeHint: Migrate any specific folder off C: — including dot-folders in your profile (e.g. C:\Users\You\.claude). Blocked: Windows, Program Files, entire Documents/AppData, and profile roots. Use the full destination path: G:\DevToolData\.claude (not G:\DevToolData alone).
toolMigration.customSourceRequired: Pick or enter the source folder to migrate.
toolMigration.customDestRequired: Pick or enter the full destination folder path.
toolMigration.customDestMustBeLeaf: For custom migration, destination must be the full target folder (e.g. G:\DevToolData\.claude), not a parent root like G:\DevToolData.
toolMigration.destRootHint: Use a parent folder on NTFS (e.g. G:\DevToolData), not G:\DevToolData\Cursor — Deco appends Cursor / Cursor-Local automatically.
toolMigration.destRootRequired: Enter a destination root (e.g. G:\DevToolData) or use Browse…
toolMigration.verifyHint: After Run, use Open source to inspect the junction at the original path and Open destination to confirm data on the new drive.
toolMigration.alreadyCompleteHint: At least one folder is already a junction to your destination. Use Open source / Open destination to verify the tool works normally, then remove leftover backup folders below.
toolMigration.backupCleanupHint: After the tool works normally (settings, extensions, chat history intact), these folders are safe to delete — they are copies left on C: during migration. Open to inspect, or delete to reclaim space.
toolMigration.planOnly: This tool is plan-only — use the manual guide or tool settings instead of Run.
toolMigration.processesRunningDetail: Close these processes before Run migration: {{processes}}. Check Task Manager and the system tray, then click Plan again.
toolMigration.planOverlayDetail: Analyzing folders and estimating size. The rest of the app is locked until this finishes.
toolMigration.runOverlayDetail: Copying data and creating the junction. This can take several minutes — do not close Deco.
toolMigration.unsupportedPlatform: Tool directory migration is available on Windows only (NTFS junction). On macOS and Linux, use the CLI on a Windows machine or wait for a future release.
